title: Caribbean Peril Codes (v2.7)
text:
Caribbean Peril Codes (v2.7) 

Peril codes for the Caribbean supported by 
UNICEDE
/2.

UNICEDE/2 supports the following codes for Perils Covered for risks in Anguilla, Antigua
 & Barbuda, Aruba, Bahamas, Barbados, Bermuda, British Virgin Islands, Cayman
 Islands, Cuba, Dominica, Dominican Republic, Grenada, Guadeloupe, Haiti, Jamaica,
 Martinique, Montserratt, Netherlands Antilles, St. Barts, St. Kits & Nevis, St.
 Maarten, St. Martin, St. Vincent & the Grenadines, Trinidad and Tobago and Turks
 & Caicos Islands:

| Use... | If risks are covered for... |
| --- | --- |
| PWS | Windstorm only |
| PEQ | Earthquake only |
